item.tib: rdzas lnga rin chen sgron ma'i brgyud zab mo
item.coloph: bdag 'dra 'gyur (kyu)ra rin chen gyis/ nyams dga' ri la 'dug pa'i dus/ nub gcig tho rangs rmi lam la/ mkhar sgang gi thang la mtshon cha dang tsher chen gyis (gyi) tshal chen po gcig la 'phyin btsam (phyin tsam) na/ rogs mang po bda' bas/ ngi rig tsho 'di la rtsal sbyong zer nas/ khong tsho mtshon cha dang tsher chen gyis (gyi) rtse mo la 'gro zhing mchong brgyug (rgyugs) kun byed do/ khong tsho mo go la nyams nga med par snang ngo / nges (ngas) ragakyang ma nus par tsha ba dang bzer (gzer) ba sngangs pa 'byung (byung) bas/ bros snang la gnyid bor nas skyi sha zing zhing ya nga bas/ gsol 'debs mang du byas pas/ skad cig la mun nag de'i nang du/ phyi nang gang yang gsal zhing / 'od kyis (kyi) yi ge bkra' lam me ba gcig shar nas byung / ngas bton dza na/ rma ri pom ra'i gsang 'gul (mgul) nas dug lnga bdud 'joms kyis (kyi) gsang sngags yod/ bskal (skal) ldan khyod kyi bon skal yin/ 'a 'ur long (longs) la bzung mthub (thub) par mdzod zer pa (nas) mi snang ngo / mno' bsam gcig (cig)btang bas ngas gter mi thon ste (te) / bzhan (gzhan) gcig gis bton nas nga la bzhin (sprad) pa e yin bsam/ gnas phun gsum (sum) 'tshogs pa'i zur khang nang*/ gter gyi zhal phye (phyes) pa'o// bkra shis par gyur cig/
